title: 2020 roadmap on pore materials for energy and environmental applications
claim: The particulate and mechanically brittle nature of many MOF crystals complicates their fabrication as continuous films.
explanation: The review suggests low-temperature organic–inorganic hybridization and molecular layer deposition as possible film-forming avenues.
scope: MOF membranes and films for energy-storage devices.
caveats: These fabrication routes are presented as prospects rather than established general solutions.
